visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white tabby cat named Uni is seen lying prone on a sleek, black reflective coffee table in a modern living room. The cat stares intently at the camera with large green eyes, its paws tucked under its chest. In the background, a white sofa and a tall cat tree are visible under soft indoor lighting. (2) The cat suddenly jumps down from the black table, landing on a light wood grain floor. It scurries across the room, its tail held high, moving quickly away from the camera. The setting is a clean, well-lit apartment with neutral walls and a dark wooden door at the end of a short hallway. (3) A hand reaches for a silver door handle and pulls a dark wood door open. An elderly man with glasses enters, pulling a dark blue suitcase and wearing a colorful horizontal striped polo shirt. A woman in a pink shirt is briefly visible in the background hallway outside near an elevator. (4) The scene shifts to the cat hiding beneath a dark wood coffee table or chair frame. The cat's body is hunched low to the floor, and its eyes are wide with caution as it watches the newcomer. The lighting is slightly dimmer under the furniture, creating high-contrast shadows. (5) The elderly man stands in the middle of the room, looking down at the cat. The cat slowly creeps out from its hiding spot and approaches the man's legs. It sniffs his blue jeans and brown slippers curiously, its ears twitching as it processes the familiar scent. (6) The grandfather smiles broadly, looking directly at the cat. He is holding a black shoulder bag and his mouth is moving as if speaking. The cat continues to circle his feet on the wooden floor, looking much more relaxed. The room is filled with bright, natural-looking artificial light. (7) Uni the cat is seen standing on a dark, marble-topped TV stand next to several purple orchids in pots. The cat looks towards the man, its gaze steady and curious. A white security camera is visible on the stand next to the cat. (8) The cat walks across the wooden floor towards the grandfather again. The man is partially visible in the frame. The cat's movement is calm and deliberate, suggesting it has recognized its owner. The apartment remains tidy and brightly lit throughout the sequence.
